questions.questionText: Each of Aditi, Aryan, Rahul, Kirti, Riya, Tanvi and Mia has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Aryan has an exam on Wednesday. Aditi has exam on the day immediately after Riya. Only two people have exams between Aryan and Riya. Rahul has exam on the day immediately after Kirti. Aryan has exam on the day immediately before Tanvi. How many people have exams after Mia?
questions.questionTextHi: अदिति, आर्यन, राहुल, कीर्ति, रिया, तन्वी और मिया में से प्रत्येक की एक सप्ताह के अलग-अलग दिन, सोमवार से शुरू होकर उसी सप्ताह के रविवार को समाप्त होने वाली परीक्षा है। आर्यन की परीक्षा बुधवार को है। अदिति की परीक्षा रिया के ठीक बाद वाले दिन है। आर्यन और रिया के बीच केवल दो व्यक्तियों की परीक्षा है। राहुल की परीक्षा कीर्ति के ठीक बाद वाले दिन है। आर्यन की परीक्षा तन्वी के ठीक पहले वाले दिन है। मिया के बाद कितने व्यक्तियों की परीक्षा है?

questions.questionText: A, Q, N, L, R and K live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. L lives on an even-numbered floor but not on the topmost floor. Only three people live between K and N. R lives immediately below Q. K lives immediately above L. A lives on the topmost floor. Who lives on floor number 3?
questions.questionTextHi: A, Q, N, L, R और K एक ही इमारत की छह अलग-अलग मंजिलों पर रहते हैं। इमारत की सबसे निचली मंजिल की संख्या 1 है, इसके ऊपर की मंजिल की संख्या 2 है और इसी तरह सबसे ऊपर की मंजिल की संख्या 6 है। L एक सम संख्या वाली मंजिल पर रहता है लेकिन सबसे ऊपर वाली मंजिल पर नहीं। K और N के बीच केवल तीन लोग रहते हैं। R, Q के ठीक नीचे रहता है। K, L के ठीक ऊपर रहता है। A सबसे ऊपर वाली मंजिल पर रहता है। मंजिल संख्या 3 पर कौन रहता है?

questions.questionText:
Refer to the following series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right. All numbers are single-digit numbers only.

(Left) 3 8 5 4 3 7 6 5 5 3 2 6 9 1 9 7 5 4 2 4 6 7 (Right)

How many such odd digits are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit?
questions.questionTextHi:
निम्नलिखित श्रेणी को देखें और दिए गए प्रश्न का उत्तर दें। गणना बाएं से दाएं की जानी चाहिए। सभी संख्याएँ केवल एक अंक की संख्याएँ हैं।

(बाएं) 3 8 5 4 3 7 6 5 5 3 2 6 9 1 9 7 5 4 2 4 6 7 (दाएं)

ऐसे कितने विषम अंक हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक के ठीक पहले एक सम अंक है और ठीक बाद में एक विषम अंक है?
questions.explanation:
Given series:

3, 8, 5, 4, 3, 7, 6, 5, 5, 3, 2, 6, 9, 1, 9, 7, 5, 4, 2, 4, 6, 7

Here, we look for the pattern: **Even digit — Odd digit — Odd digit**

Now,

3, 8, 5, **4, 3, 7**, **6, 5, 5,** 3, 2, **6, 9, 1,** 9, 7, 5, 4, 2, 4, 6, 7

So, valid occurrences = 3

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.questionText: In a code language, 'DEAR' is coded as 16 and 'ANGEL' is coded as 25. How will 'BEHAVIOR' be coded in the same language?
questions.questionTextHi: एक कूट भाषा में, 'DEAR' को 16 के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाता है और 'ANGEL' को 25 के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाता है। उस भाषा में 'BEHAVIOR' को कैसे कूटबद्ध किया जाएगा?
questions.explanation:
Given:

DEAR → 16

ANGEL → 25

Now, For DEAR:

Number of letters = 4

⇒ 4² = 16

For, ANGEL:

Number of letters = 5

⇒ 5² = 25

Now, for BEHAVIOR:

B E H A V I O R → 8 letters

⇒ 8² = 64

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

questions.questionText: Wasim starts from Point A and drives 24 km towards the south. He then takes a right turn, drives 24 km, turns right and drives 31 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 33 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.questionTextHi: वसीम बिंदु A से शुरू होता है और दक्षिण दिशा में 24 किमी चलता है। फिर वह दाएँ मुड़ता है, 24 किमी चलता है, दाएँ मुड़ता है और 31 किमी चलता है। फिर वह दाएँ मुड़ता है और 33 किमी चलता है। वह अंतिम बार दाएँ मुड़ता है, 7 किमी चलता है और बिंदु P पर रुक जाता है। बिंदु A पर फिर से पहुँचने के लिए उसे कितनी दूर (सबसे कम दूरी) और किस दिशा में चलना चाहिए? (जब तक निर्दिष्ट न किया जाए, सभी मोड़ 90-डिग्री के मोड़ हैं।)
questions.explanation:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Wasim starts from Point A (0, 0)

He moves 24 km South

He turns right → 24 km West

He turns right → 31 km North

He turns right → 33 km East

He turns right → 7 km South

So, To return to Point A, he must move **9 km West**.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

questions.explanation:
Given:

A lives on an even-numbered floor (2, 4, or 6).

T lives immediately below A.

W lives immediately above O, and O is not on Floor 1.

 
	 
		 
			 Floor 
			 Person 
		 
	 
	 
		 
			 6 
			 B 
		 
		 
			 5 
			 W 
		 
		 
			 4 
			 O 
		 
		 
			 3 
			 L 
		 
		 
			 2 
			 A 
		 
		 
			 1 
			 T 
		 
	 
 

Now, O lives on floor number 4.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

(ध्यान दें: संक्रियाएँ पूर्ण संख्याओं पर की जानी चाहिए, संख्याओं को उनके घटक अंकों में तोड़े बिना। उदा. 13 - 13 पर संक्रियाएँ जैसे जोड़ना/घटाना/गुणा करना आदि 13 पर किया जा सकता है। 13 को 1 और 3 में तोड़कर फिर 1 और 3 पर गणितीय संक्रियाएँ करना अनुमत नहीं है)

\( 469 : ? :: 667 : 2673 :: 958 : 3837 \)
questions.explanation:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** **The pattern is that each number is multiplied by 4 and then increased by 5 to obtain the result.**

For, 667 : 2673

667 × 4 = 2668

2668 + 5 = 2673

For, 958 : 3837

958 × 4 = 3832

3832 + 5 = 3837

Now, 469 : ?

469 × 4 = 1876

1876 + 5 = 1881

So, 469 → 1881

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

questions.questionText: In a certain code language, 'MASTER' is coded as '85' and 'CARE' is coded as '80'. How will 'SCHOOL' be coded in that code language?
questions.questionTextHi: एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में, 'MASTER' को '85' और 'CARE' को '80' के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाता है। उसी कूट भाषा में 'SCHOOL' को कैसे कूटबद्ध किया जाएगा?
questions.explanation:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Sum of opposite numbers.**

For, MASTER → 85

Sum = 14 + 26 + 8 + 7 + 22 + 9 = 86

86 − 1 = 85

For, CARE → 80

Sum = 24 + 26 + 9 + 22 = 81

81 − 1 = 80

Now, SCHOOL →

Sum = 8 + 24 + 19 + 12 + 12 + 15 = 90

90 − 1 = 89

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

The logic followed here is:

Given:

acodemic marks important → pd rs ln

marks shows rank → rs tn pq

rank generate merit → tn lq zx

Therefore, marks rank → rs tn

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

If the sum of 35 and 46 is multiplied by 2

(बायें) 6 £ 2 @ % 7 8 # 1 3 * 9 $ & 4 ^ ≺ 5 (दायें)

ऐसे कितने प्रतीक हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक के ठीक पहले एक संख्या है और उसके ठीक बाद एक और संख्या भी है?
questions.explanation:
Given: (Left) 6 £ 2 @ % 7 8 # 1 3 * 9 $ & 4 ^ ≺ 5 (Right)

Now,

Symbols, which are immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

So, Needed pattern is: **Number - Symbol - Number.**

(Left) **6 £ 2** @ % 7 **8 # 1** **3 * 9** $ & 4 ^ ≺ 5 (Right)

Thus, three symbols satisfy the condition.

Hence, the correct answer is** Option 4.**

18 is related to 321 following a certain logic. Following the same logic,13 is related to 166. To which of the given options is 25 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.questionTextHi:
18 एक निश्चित तर्क का अनुसरण करते हुए 321 से संबंधित है। समान तर्क का अनुसरण करते हुए, 13, 166 से संबंधित है। समान तर्क का अनुसरण करते हुए, दिए गए विकल्पों में से 25 किससे संबंधित है?

(NOTE: संक्रियाएँ पूर्ण संख्याओं पर की जानी चाहिए, संख्याओं को उनके घटक अंकों में तोड़े बिना। उदा. 13 - 13 में जोड़ने/घटाने/गुणा करने जैसी संक्रियाएँ की जा सकती हैं। 13 को 1 और 3 में तोड़ना और फिर 1 और 3 पर गणितीय संक्रियाएँ करना अनुमत नहीं है।)
questions.explanation:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The pattern is based on the operation: (Square of the number) − 3.

For, **18 → 321**

⇒ (182 = 324)

⇒ 324 − 3 = 321

For, **13 → 166**

⇒ (132 = 169)

⇒ 169 − 3 = 166

Now, applying the same pattern for 25:

25 → ?

⇒ (252 = 625)

⇒ 625 − 3 = 622

Hence, the number related to 25 is 622.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**

questions.questionText: In a code language, 'HUGE' is coded as 82 and 'MERCY' is coded as 128. How will 'ASPECT' be coded in the same language?
questions.questionTextHi: एक कूट भाषा में, 'HUGE' को 82 और 'MERCY' को 128 के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया गया है। उसी भाषा में 'ASPECT' को कैसे कूटबद्ध किया जाएगा?
questions.explanation:
Given:

HUGE → 82

MERCY → 128

For, HUGE

H = 8, U = 21, G = 7, E = 5

⇒ 8 + 21 + 7 + 5 = 41

⇒ 41 × 2 = 82

For, MERCY

M = 13, E = 5, R = 18, C = 3, Y = 25

⇒ 13 + 5 + 18 + 3 + 25 = 64

⇒ 64 × 2 = 128

Now, for ASPECT:

A = 1, S = 19, P = 16, E = 5, C = 3, T = 20

⇒ 1 + 19 + 16 + 5 + 3 + 20 = 64

⇒ 64 × 2 = 128

Hence, the correct answer is **Option (3).**

\( 9670 : ? :: 4889 : 4851 :: 5596 : 5558 \)
questions.questionTextHi:
वह विकल्प चुनें जो पहले नंबर से उसी तरह संबंधित है जैसे चौथा नंबर तीसरे नंबर से और छठा नंबर पांचवें नंबर से संबंधित है।

(ध्यान दें: संक्रियाएँ पूर्ण संख्याओं पर की जानी चाहिए, संख्याओं को उनके घटक अंकों में तोड़े बिना। उदा.13 - 13 पर संक्रियाएँ जैसे 13 में जोड़ना/घटाना/गुणा करना आदि किया जा सकता है। 13 को 1 और 3 में तोड़ना और फिर 1 और 3 पर गणितीय संक्रियाएँ करना अनुमत नहीं है)

\( 9670 : ? :: 4889 : 4851 :: 5596 : 5558 \)
questions.explanation:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Each output is obtained by subtracting a fixed number, 38, from the given number.**

For, 4889 : 4851

4889 − 38 = 4851

For,  5596 : 5558

5596 − 38 = 5558

Now, 9670 : ?

9670 − 38 = 9632

So, 9670 → 9632

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

questions.questionTextHi:
उस विकल्प का चयन करें जो छठे संख्या से उसी प्रकार संबंधित है जैसे पहली संख्या दूसरी संख्या से संबंधित है और तीसरी संख्या चौथी संख्या से संबंधित है।

(ध्यान दें: संक्रियाएँ पूर्ण संख्याओं पर की जानी चाहिए, संख्याओं को उसके घटक अंकों में विभाजित किए बिना। उदाहरण के लिए 13 - 13 पर संक्रियाएँ जैसे जोड़ना/घटाना/गुणा करना आदि की जा सकती हैं। 13 को 1 और 3 में विभाजित करना और फिर 1 और 3 पर गणितीय संक्रियाएँ करना अनुमत नहीं है)

\( 654 : 2610 :: 466 : 1858 :: ? : 322 \)
questions.explanation:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** **The pattern follows the rule: multiply the number by 4 and then subtract 6.**

For, 654 : 2610

654 × 4 = 2616

2616 − 6 = 2610

For, 466 : 1858

466 × 4 = 1864

1864 − 6 = 1858

Now, ? : 322

Let the number be X

X × 4 − 6 = 322

4X = 322 + 6 = 328

X = 328 ÷ 4 = 82

So, ? = 82

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

questions.questionText: Two numbers are in ratio 7:9, and their sum is 128. Find the numbers.
questions.questionTextHi: दो संख्याएँ 7:9 के अनुपात में हैं, और उनका योग 128 है। संख्याएँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Ratio of two numbers = 7:9

Sum of two numbers = 128

**Formula used:**

Let the numbers be 7x and 9x. Their sum is:

7x + 9x = 128

**Calculations:**

⇒ 16x = 128

⇒ x = 128 ÷ 16

⇒ x = 8

First number = 7x = 7 × 8 = 56

Second number = 9x = 9 × 8 = 72

**∴ The correct answer is option (2): 56, 72.**

questions.questionText: If 16 + 11 = A and \(\frac{1}{9}\) = B, and A% B = (A × B) - 1, then what is A% B?
questions.questionTextHi: यदि 16+11=A और \(\frac{1}{9}\)=B है, और A % B=(A × B)-1 है, तो A % B क्या है?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

If 16 + 11 = A and (1)/(9)=B, A % B = (A×B)-1, then find A % B.

**Formula used:**

A % B = (A×B) - 1

**Calculations:**

A = 16 + 11 = 27

B = 1/9

A % B = (A×B) - 1

⇒ A % B = (27×1/9) - 1

⇒ A % B = 3 - 1

⇒ A % B = 2

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

**Given:**

Sum of 28 and 22 = 28 + 22

Multiplier = 8

**Formula used:**

Total = (Sum) × Multiplier

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total = (28 + 22) × 8

⇒ Total = 50 × 8

⇒ Total = 400

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.questionText: In the author’s view, what determines whether social media supports or undermines democracy?

This is correct because the author emphasizes that the impact of social media on democracy depends on how society uses it ethically and with responsible intent.

questions.questionText: The expenditure of a household on food, clothing, and entertainment is in the ratio 2 : 4 : 4. In the coming year, the cost of food is expected to fall by 10%, clothing to rise by 5%, and entertainment to fall by 15%. What is the percent change (increase or decrease) in the total household expenditure?
questions.questionTextHi: एक परिवार का भोजन, वस्त्र और मनोरंजन पर व्यय 2 : 4 : 4 के अनुपात में है। आने वाले वर्ष में, भोजन की लागत में 10% की गिरावट, कपड़ों की लागत में 5% की वृद्धि और मनोरंजन की लागत में 15% की गिरावट आने की उम्मीद है। कुल घरेलू व्यय में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन (वृद्धि या कमी) क्या है?

questions.explanation: $da

questions.questionText: Two individuals, A and B, have rented a field. A places 21 horses in the field for 6 months and 15 cows for 2 months. B adds 15 cows for 6 months and 40 sheep for 7.5 months. If 3 horses consume the same amount of food as 5 cows, and 6 cows eat as much as 10 sheep, what portion of the rent should A cover?
questions.questionTextHi: दो व्यक्तियों, A और B ने एक खेत किराए पर लिया है। वह 6 माह के लिए खेत में 21 घोड़े और 2 माह के लिए 15 गायें रखता है। B, 6 माह के लिए 15 गायें और 7.5 माह के लिए 40 भेड़ें रखता है। यदि 3 घोड़े 5 गायों के बराबर भोजन खाते हैं, और 6 गायें 10 भेड़ों के बराबर खाती हैं, तो A को किराए का कितना भाग देना चाहिए?

questions.questionText: Two individuals, A and B rent a pasture. A uses 16 cows for a duration of 3 months and 20 sheep for 4 months and B uses 30 sheep for 6 months. If 4 cows are equivalent to 8 sheep, determine A's portion of the rent.

questions.questionText: Three groups of students have average ages 18, 20, and 22 respectively. If the number of students in the three groups is in the ratio 2:3:5, what is the overall average age?

questions.explanation: $ee

questions.questionText: A mobile phone retailer sells a phone for ₹P and earns a profit of 20%. For a special festive offer, he marks the same phone at ₹1.5P. At the offer, he provides a discount of 10%. What will be the percentage profit that he will make during the festive offer?

questions.questionText: A shopkeeper marks his goods at 60% above the cost price. He allows a discount of 25% on the marked price. If he also gives an additional cash discount of ₹150, and still makes a profit of 14% on the cost price, what is the cost price of the goods?
questions.questionTextHi: एक दुकानदार अपने माल पर क्रय मूल्य से 60% अधिक मूल्य अंकित करता है। वह अंकित मूल्य पर 25% की छूट देता है। यदि वह ₹150 की अतिरिक्त नकद छूट भी देता है, और फिर भी क्रय मूल्य पर 14% का लाभ अर्जित करता है, तो माल का क्रय मूल्य क्या है?

questions.questionText: A vertical cylindrical container is filled with oil. A solid hemispherical stone of radius 7 cm is immersed completely, and the oil level rises by 3 cm. What is the radius of the cylinder?

questions.questionText: A sector of a circle has a central angle of 120° and a radius of 7 cm. Another sector of the same circle has a central angle of \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\) radians. What is the ratio of the area of the first sector to the area of the second sector?

questions.questionText:
Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:
In the tapestry of human civilization, communication functions as the warp thread-a foundational axis around which all societal patterns are woven. Far from being a mere conduit of information, communication embodies the dynamic interplay of perception, cognition, intention, and empathy. The profound necessity of communication arises not solely from the need to disseminate knowledge or coordinate actions, but from the imperative to construct meaning, cultivate understanding, and negotiate the complex terrain of human relationships. Historically, communication has been the catalytic force behind societal transformation-from the oral traditions that preserved mythological cosmologies to the written word that enabled legal systems and codified morality. The printing press, the telegraph, and now digital media are not just technological milestones; they are paradigmatic shifts in the communicative capacity of humankind. Each advancement has not only expanded the velocity and reach of messages but has also redefined the epistemological contours of truth, authority, and discourse. At the interpersonal level, communication is far from unidirectional. It encompasses verbal, non-verbal, and paralinguistic dimensions that function in concert to convey nuance and intention. Eye contact, silence, body posture, and even prosody become carriers of latent meaning-often transcending the spoken word. The failure to decode or acknowledge these layers frequently leads to misapprehension, conflict, or alienation. Thus, effective communication is not merely the transmission of speech, but the art of calibrated expression and attentive reception. In professional and organizational contexts, the strategic deployment of communication is pivotal. It determines leadership efficacy, influences team cohesion, and governs decision-making processes. Hierarchical structures often obfuscate open communication, resulting in informational asymmetries and the erosion of institutional trust. In contrast, transparent, dialogic, and inclusive communication frameworks nurture a culture of accountability and innovation. Cultural semiotics also shape communication, embedding within language a constellation of values, assumptions, and power dynamics. What is deemed assertive in one cultural matrix may be interpreted as aggressive in another. Consequently, intercultural communication necessitates a heightened awareness of contextual sensitivity, linguistic pluralism, and implicit biases. In an era marked by algorithmic echo chambers and hyper-mediated realities, the ethical imperative of responsible communication becomes paramount. The virality of misinformation, the commodification of attention, and the erosion of discourse norms threaten the democratic fabric of societies. Hence, communicative competence today must be coupled with critical media literacy, epistemic humility, and ethical discernment. Ultimately, communication is not ancillary to human existence-it is constitutive of it. To communicate is to assert presence, to co-create reality, and to engage in the continuous reconstitution of the social world. In its highest form, communication becomes a moral act: a commitment to understanding, mutuality, and the transcendence of solipsism.


Which of the following best encapsulates the primary thesis of the passage?

questions.questionText:
Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:
While financial inclusion is often praised as a driver of equitable growth, its implementation in rural India presents a paradox. On paper, schemes such as the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), Aadhaar-enabled payment systems, and mobile banking have revolutionized access. Yet, in practice, access does not necessarily translate into utility. A significant number of rural account holders remain dormant users, often constrained by digital illiteracy, infrastructural limitations, and deeply entrenched socio-cultural barriers. In numerous villages, banking correspondents (BCS)-the foot soldiers of India's rural financial architecture are overburdened, undertrained, and often unsupported by robust technological infrastructure. The notion that a biometric fingerprint or a one-time password could substitute for financial literacy is naïve at best. Many beneficiaries, especially women, face systemic exclusion, not just due to lack of documentation, but because patriarchal norms often discourage or control women's interactions with banking services. Moreover, while financial inclusion aims to integrate the rural poor into the formal economy, the informal credit system continues to flourish. This coexistence is not accidental but symptomatic of a trust deficit and functional inefficiencies within formal institutions. Local moneylenders, albeit exploitative, offer immediacy and familiarity, elements often absent in bureaucratic banking processes. The digital push, accelerated post-2016 demonetization and COVID-19, has undoubtedly expanded the ecosystem. However, digital penetration without digital comprehension can widen the exclusion gap. Without focused digital education, grievance redressal mechanisms, and gender-sensitive outreach, financial inclusion may remain more rhetorical than real. In essence, true inclusion cannot be measured merely by the number of accounts opened but must reflect active participation, trust, and accessibility across gender, literacy, and regional lines. Until then, the dream of a financially empowered rural India will remain aspirational.
According to the passage, what is the main paradox of financial inclusion in rural India?

- **Correct Answer:** Option (3) — **"Access without actual usage"**
